profile.name: LabRAD Twisted连接组件
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件连接组件，用于与LabRAD管理器建立和维护同步连接、派生新连接、创建通信上下文，并向目标服务发送请求或消息。它主要用于实验控制软件中的服务发现、设置查询和进程间通信，而不是直接控制某台实体仪器。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software connection component for establishing and maintaining a synchronous connection to a LabRAD manager, spawning new connections, creating communication contexts, and sending requests or messages to target services. It is mainly used for service discovery, setting inspection, and inter-process communication in lab automation software, rather than for direct control of a physical instrument.

registry.name: Twisted
registry.description: Twisted Connection是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, context等操作。
